guideImpact.reason: The verified launcher presents users with 12 available module cards and an Open control on every card. The guide should explain how users identify and open available modules from the V4 launcher.

guideUpdate.title: Open a module from the V4 launcher
steps: Open the configured V4 launcher page.
Wait for the Metricell Launcher module grid to appear.
Locate the card for the module you want to use.
Select the Open module control on that card.
guideUpdate.reason: The verified launcher displays 12 available module cards, each with its own Open module control.
